title: Lightweight component guides with migration checklist and live snippets
creator: Ava Bennett
description: Scope: Create compact, consumable component pages (tokens, buttons, tables, charts) that prioritize usage guidance, quick 'do/don't' callouts, and small live code snippets developers can copy. Aim to reduce overlong reference pages and provide a clear migration checklist for teams moving from legacy tokens/components to the new system. Deliver a template page, four exemplar pages, and a migration checklist that can be embedded into the migration playbook. Rationale: current docs are long, duplicative, and difficult to skim during implementation. Lightweight pages improve discoverability and reduce engineering onboarding time. Out-of-scope: full rewrite of component API surface (separate ENG work) and interactive playground iteration (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: One lightweight template page for component docs validated by 2 frontend engineers and 1 PM
Four exemplar pages produced: tokens, primary button, data table, chart (example: spark/line)
Each page includes: 1-line intent, 3 usage patterns with images, 3 "Do / Don't" callouts, 2 short copy-paste snippets (JSX and CSS vars), and accessibility notes
A migration checklist with step-by-step actions and links to code mod PRs and deprecation timeline
Docs hosted in the docs site branch with automated preview link and reviewed PR
No regressions in existing doc search/results (sanity check by docs owner)
design_notes: Prefer concise visual examples (120-200px) — avoid full-screen mockups to keep page scan-friendly
Use token swatches with copy-to-clipboard CSS var snippet (token name + fallback example)
For buttons, show primary/secondary/ghost with spacing and keyboard focus state; include recommended padding tokens
For tables, include example of row density options and recommended column width tokens; surface sorting/row-selection notes
Charts should include data density guidance and recommended axis token usage to keep visuals consistent across dashboards

implementation_plan: Week 1: Create template page, tokens quick reference, and review with eng for token names
Week 2: Produce button and table pages with short snippets and screenshots, iterate on copy with PM
Week 3: Produce chart example and finalize migration checklist; open docs PR and gather reviews
Week 4: Merge and publish; monitor doc search traffic and collect feedback for follow-up improvements
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Codemod or token renames land late which will invalidate snippets — Mitigation: add a "last verified" token version and include fallback examples
Risk: Page proliferation if teams request many variations — Mitigation: provide guidance for 'variants' and link to component playground for advanced cases
Risk: Accessibility edge cases missed — Mitigation: include accessibility checklist and request a quick audit from accessibility engineer
